purpose: Post-corruption repository artifact integrity repair. Detects and repairs a malformed JSON separator in the maintained skill catalog audit without changing canonical skill or relationship data.

finding.issue: The latest_research_batch property contained a duplicated comma (553,,), making the audit artifact invalid JSON.
finding.impact: Consumer parsers could fail even though the canonical skill and PQ reward stores remained structurally intact.

repair.change: Replaced the malformed 553,, separator with the valid 553, separator.

evidence_boundary: This repair restores artifact syntax only. It does not infer missing skills, relationships, version assignments, acquisition conditions, probabilities, or mechanics.
